characters.name: Gaston
characters.role: Royal herald of King Charles; delivers the tournament invitation and guides the initial diplomatic contact.

characters.name: King Charles
characters.role: King of Bretonnia; tournament host and political patron of the Dragon Rider delegation.

characters.name: Archbishop Anselm
characters.role: Powerful head or senior representative of the Bretonnian Church; initially suspicious of dragons and central to the religious conflict.

characters.name: Master Bertrand
characters.role: Riding master who trains the Dragon Riders in horseback jousting and lance technique.

characters.name: Count Bernier
characters.role: Noble insider who organizes or leads the political conspiracy against King Charles.

characters.name: Lord Raymond
characters.role: King Charles's cousin and politically important kidnapping victim; exact constitutional importance still undefined.

characters.name: Warlord Lothar
characters.role: Commander of the invading army in the siege arc; relationship to Bernier remains undefined.

note: All VOD4-specific characters remain production-level/proposed until the story plan is accepted or prose establishes them.
